column1: # Architecture-check baseline. Generated by `sbt writeArchitectureBaseline`.
# Targets: method <= 80 lines, file <= 600 lines, no forbidden imports or calls.
# This list may shrink, never grow. Removing an entry is the point.
# Growth must be justified: CI fails a PR that grows this file's entry count or total measured
# lines/hits unless the same diff adds a '# paydown: <why, issue link>' comment line (see #1413).
# Columns: path <TAB> detail <TAB> measured

# `LifecycleIntent.Restart` case to its lifecycle interpreter, the same one-line-per-intent shape as QuitApp/ResolveClose.
# The same regeneration also corrects Rope, PerformanceBenchmarks and StateManagerCapabilitySpec, whose recorded sizes
# had drifted above what the tree measures.

# paydown: purity ratchet (#1677). The mutability check is now declaration-level and word-boundary, with new tokens
# (ConcurrentHashMap, AtomicLong/Boolean, ThreadLocal, java.util collections) and an object-held-stateful-instance rule.
# The 10 method-local entries it used to record are gone; the entries below are real object-held caches and counters
# that later PRs move into runtime-owned state. Items that can never move are in ArchitectureChecks.PurityAllowlist.
